receipt.name: WarmJpegDecode

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm JPEG decode FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. For subsampled inputs, expand both ceil-sized chroma planes by their sampling factors and crop to the original grid inside every operation, including intermediate acquisition/release. Grayscale includes expanding owned decoded GRAY8 samples into independent RGBA8 inside every operation. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

receipt.name: WarmNearestResize
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster to independently owned 256x129 nearest output at the same sample depth. Complete public Resize, admission, allocation/materialization/disposal. Native public FFmpeg filter graph includes packing/plane extraction, separate RGB and replicated-alpha zscale point kernels, merging, output pixel allocation/release. Graph/source/frame wrappers and geometry contexts are reused; every call filters every selected sample. Native padded output rows exposed directly. Exact integer center mapping, alpha and hidden RGB. No codec, expression evaluator or output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this downsample case is measured.

receipt.name: WarmTranspose
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster transposed into an independent owned 259x513 raster at the same depth. Complete public Transpose(mirrored:false), admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg transpose graph allocates/processes independent pixels and releases output inside every operation. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly; no redundant packing/materialization copy. Exact transpose placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original raster is measured.
